tagline: Government schemes you can get, in one place
hero_title: Which government schemes can you get?
hero_sub: Answer four questions. We show the central and state schemes that fit you, what each one gives, and exactly how to apply.
more_sub: These help us show schemes that need them. Nothing is stored.
q_bpl: My family has a BPL, Antyodaya or priority ration card
q_minority: I belong to a minority community
q_pregnant: I am pregnant or have a baby under 1
err_required: Fill in all four blanks to see your schemes.
need_title: What do you need help with?
states_note: {c} central schemes apply everywhere in India. Pick your state to see its own schemes too.
fake_body: Messages promising a free laptop, sewing machine, phone recharge or cash “from the Prime Minister” are usually fake. Real schemes never ask you to pay money or share an OTP to apply. Check suspicious messages at factcheck.pib.gov.in.
trust_body: Every “Open the official website” button goes to a government website. YogyataSetu never asks for your Aadhaar number, bank details, OTP or money.
numbers: {n} schemes from {s} states and union territories, and the Central Government.
maybe_sub: These need something you have not told us. Fill “More about you” for a sharper list.
none_title: No schemes fit these details yet
none_body: Try “doing something else” as your work, or look through all schemes. We add new schemes and states regularly.
verify_text: This scheme may have changed recently. Confirm the details on the official website or at the office before you apply.
search_ph: Search by name or benefit, e.g. pension, scholarship
how_apply: How to apply, step by step
documents_note: Tick each one as you collect it. The official website or office has the final list.
find_official_note: We have not added the official link for this scheme yet. This searches only government websites.
report: Something wrong or out of date?
report_thanks: Thank you. Our team will check this.
steps_note: Stuck? Any Common Service Centre (CSC) can do these steps for you for a small fee.
n_urban: living in a town or city
saved_sub: Schemes you save stay on this phone or computer only.
saved_empty: You have not saved any schemes yet. Tap “Save” on a scheme to keep it here.
about_lead: India runs hundreds of welfare schemes, but millions of people who qualify never hear about them. YogyataSetu is a bridge between citizens and the schemes meant for them.
p2: Information spread across many government websites
p3: Eligibility rules that are hard to understand
p4: Gaps in digital access and literacy
a1: Match you to schemes using your age, gender, work and state.
a2: Explain each scheme in plain words in 12 languages.
a3: Show the exact steps to apply and link only to official government sources.
r2: Website with central and state schemes in 12 languages
r3: Mobile app and more schemes for every state
r4: NGO and CSR partnerships for on-ground awareness
r5: Voice search, application tracking and alerts
disclaimer: YogyataSetu is an independent information service, not a government website. Rules change often. Always confirm on the official website before applying.
footer_made: So that no eligible citizen is left behind.
not_found: We could not find that page.
translated_note: Some scheme details are shown in English because they are not translated yet.
d_estimate: Treatment cost estimate from the hospital
d_affidavit: Affidavit that she is the only child
d_work_cert: Certificate of 90 days of construction work
s_aadhaar: Enter your Aadhaar number and mobile number.
s_otp: Type the OTP (one-time password) sent to your mobile.
s_land: Enter your land details (khasra or survey number) and upload the land record.
s_upload: Upload clear photos or scans of your documents.
s_submit: Submit, and write down your application or reference number.
s_ekyc: Complete e-KYC with Aadhaar OTP or your fingerprint.
s_status: Later, check your status on the same website under “{label}”.
s_register: Register with your mobile number and create a password.
s_fee: Pay the fee, if there is one.
s_note_deadline: Apply before the deadline for each crop season. Farmers with crop loans are usually enrolled by their bank.
s_ask: Ask for the “{name}” form, or ask the staff to apply for you.
s_wait: Officials check your application. Money is paid straight into your bank account.
s_state_portal: Your state runs this scheme. Open your state’s link from the list on the website.
s_fee_first: Pay the first monthly contribution in cash at the centre.
s_soil_sample: Staff take a soil sample from your field, or you take one to the soil testing lab.
s_project: Prepare a simple project report: what you will make or sell, the cost and the income you expect.
s_bank_followup: The bank checks your project and gives the loan.
s_checklist_self: Check if your family is on the list by searching your name, ration card or Aadhaar.
s_app: You can also do this on the {app} mobile app.
s_hospital: At a listed hospital, go to the Ayushman Mitra or help desk with your card and Aadhaar. Treatment is cashless.
s_register_pregnancy: Register your pregnancy with the ASHA or ANM, or at the Anganwadi, and get an MCP card.
s_hospital_delivery: Have your baby at a government or accredited hospital.
s_auto_free: No application needed. It is free at government health centres.
s_call_ambulance: Call 102 or 108 for a free ambulance.
s_go_on_9th: Go to your nearest government health centre on the 9th of any month.
s_register_anganwadi: Register at your local Anganwadi with the child’s birth certificate or MCP card.
s_carry_prescription: Take your doctor’s prescription to the nearest Janaushadhi store.
s_tb_register: Your doctor registers you on Ni-kshay when TB treatment starts. Give your bank details.
s_doctor_estimate: Get a written cost estimate from the treating doctor at a government hospital.
s_premium: The yearly premium is taken automatically from your bank account.
s_choose_pension: Choose the pension amount you want. Your monthly payment depends on your age.
s_deposit: Deposit money every year (there is a small minimum).
s_checklist: Check if your name is on the beneficiary list.
s_choose_company: Choose a gas company (Indane, Bharat Gas or HP Gas) and a distributor near you.
s_electricity: Enter your electricity consumer number and mobile number.
s_vendor: Choose a registered vendor to install the panels. After installation, the subsidy comes to your bank account.
s_build_toilet: Build the toilet. Officials check it with a photo before paying.
s_fingerprint: Give your fingerprint on the machine at the ration shop.
s_onorc: Moved to another state? You can take your ration from any ration shop in India with the same card.
s_auto_school: No application needed. Your child gets it at school.
s_institute_verify: Your school or college checks and approves the application online.
s_state_portal_or_nsp: Some states use their own scholarship website. Ask your college which one to use.
s_choose_bank: Choose the bank you want the loan from.
s_school: Apply through your school or college. Ask the principal or the scholarship teacher.
s_choose_internships: Choose up to 5 internships you like and apply.
s_jobcard: If your family has no job card, apply for one at the Gram Panchayat.
s_demand_work: Ask for work in writing at the Gram Panchayat. You must be given work within 15 days.
s_choose_course: Choose a course and a training centre near you.
s_visit_centre: Go to the training centre on the start date with your documents.
s_epf_uan: Your employer registers you with EPFO and you get a UAN number.
s_activate_uan: Activate your UAN using face authentication on the UMANG app.
s_search_jobs: Search and apply for jobs, and look for job fairs near you.
s_apply_openings: Search for apprenticeship openings and apply.
s_join_shg: Join a women’s self-help group in your area. The support comes through the group.
s_or_bank: Or apply directly at a bank branch.
s_edp_training: Finish the short business training before the loan is released.
s_gp_verify: Your Gram Panchayat or municipal body confirms your trade.
s_training: Attend the basic training. You get a daily allowance.
s_or_csc: Or apply at a Common Service Centre (CSC).
s_dpiit: First get your startup recognised by DPIIT on the Startup India website.
s_choose_incubator: Choose up to 3 incubators and apply through them.
s_medical_board: A government medical board examines you and gives the certificate.
s_camp: Go to the assessment camp, then collect your aid on the distribution day.
s_bank: Enter your bank account number and IFSC code.
s_visit: Go to your nearest {places} with your documents.
s_home_delivery: The pension is handed to you at home at the start of every month.
s_show_id_bus: Just get on the bus and show your Aadhaar or ID card. No application needed.
s_find_canteen: Go to the nearest canteen. No card is needed.
s_auto_bill: No application needed. It is applied to your electricity bill automatically.
s_auto_pmkisan: No separate application. If you get PM-Kisan, you get this too.
s_auto_land: No application needed. It is paid using your land records.
s_link_janaadhaar: Link your LPG connection to your Jan Aadhaar.
s_door_to_door: Officials also come door to door to help fill in forms.
s_face_auth: Complete face authentication on the NSP OTR app or at a CSC.
check_lead: Paste a scheme name, a link, or a WhatsApp/SMS message. We tell you if the scheme is real, fake or a scam, and why.
check_ph: e.g. PM Free Laptop Yojana, or paste the whole message
check_private: We don't save what you paste unless you report it.
check_limits: This check uses our list of real schemes and fakes reported by PIB Fact Check. It can be wrong. When in doubt, ask at the official helpline or your nearest CSC.
check_msg_t: Got a message about this scheme?
check_msg_b: Check if it is real before you click or pay.
err_empty: Type or paste something to check.
err_rate: Too many checks from your network. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
r_confirmed: Our team has reviewed this exact message.
r_no_signals: We found no warning signs in the text.
v_real_b: This is a real government scheme. Apply only on the official website or at a government office.
v_caution_b: The scheme is real, but this message has warning signs. Don't use its links or numbers. Use the official website below.
v_fake_b: This scheme does not exist. The government has said it is fake. Don't fill any form, share documents or pay money.
v_scam_b: This message has clear signs of fraud. Don't click links, share OTP or pay anything.
v_official_b: This link goes to a government website. Still check the address bar before you type any details.
v_unsure_b: We didn't find an exact match. It may be one of the schemes below. Scammers often change a real scheme's name slightly.
v_suspicious_b: We couldn't find this scheme, and the message has warning signs. Treat it as a scam until an official source confirms it.
v_unknown_b: We checked {n} real schemes and known fakes and found no match. That doesn't prove it is fake. Check on myscheme.gov.in or call the helpline before you share any details.
sig_fee: Asks for a registration, processing or approval fee. Government schemes don't charge a fee to give you money.
sig_pay: Asks you to pay or send money.
sig_upi: Asks for payment by UPI or QR code. Schemes never collect money this way.
sig_otp: Asks for your OTP, PIN or password. No real official will ever ask for these.
sig_apk: Asks you to install an app file (APK). These apps can steal your bank details.
sig_remote: Asks you to install a screen-sharing app like AnyDesk or TeamViewer. This lets someone control your phone.
sig_card: Asks for your card number or CVV.
sig_bank: Asks you to send Aadhaar or bank details by chat.
sig_prize: Says you have won or been selected. Real schemes don't pick people by lucky draw.
sig_invest: Promises big returns on an investment. The government doesn't run schemes like this.
sig_urgent: Rushes you ("today only"). Scammers hurry you so you don't check.
sig_forward: Asks you to forward it to many people.
sig_free_gift: Promises free gadgets like a laptop, phone, recharge or scooty. Most such offers are fake.
sig_everyone: Promises money to everyone in a big group. Real schemes have eligibility rules.
sig_mobile: Gives a personal mobile number to contact. Schemes use official helplines.
sig_ip_link: The link is a number, not a website name.
sig_short_link: Uses a short link that hides where it goes.
sig_form_link: Collects details on a Google Form or similar, not a government website.
sig_free_host: The website is on a free hosting service, not a government site.
sig_chat_link: The link opens a WhatsApp or Telegram chat.
sig_fake_domain: The website name looks like a government site but isn't one. Real ones end in .gov.in or .nic.in.
sig_social_link: The link goes to social media, not an official website.
sig_unofficial_link: The link is not an official government website.
do_dont: Don't click the links, call the numbers or pay money mentioned in the message.
do_otp: Never share your OTP, PIN, password or bank details with anyone.
do_1930: Lost money? Call 1930 at once or report at cybercrime.gov.in.
do_chakshu: Report the fraud call or message on Sanchar Saathi (Chakshu).
do_pib: Forward it to PIB Fact Check on WhatsApp to get it checked.
do_official: Apply only on the official website or at your nearest CSC or government office.
do_free: Applying for a government scheme is free. Never pay an agent or a "registration fee".
do_ask: Look it up on myscheme.gov.in or ask at your nearest CSC.
report_body: Report it so we can warn others. The text you checked will be saved for our team to review.
report_done: Thank you. Your report helps protect others.
how_1: We compare it with {n} real schemes and with fake schemes reported by PIB Fact Check, even with spelling mistakes or in your language.
how_2: We look for what scammers ask for: fees, OTP, UPI payments, app downloads, "today only" pressure.
how_3: Real government websites end in .gov.in or .nic.in. We flag look-alikes, short links and forms.
rule_gov: Real government websites end in .gov.in or .nic.in. Check the address before you type anything.
